_comment: MissionChief US (missionchief.com) prices. 'source' is the provenance and is the most important field in this file. build_menu = read by the player from the live in-game build menu, treat as truth. wiki_table = a building list the player pasted that has since been shown to contain outdated entries, treat as weak. estimate = a heuristic guess by Claude, NOT data, must be replaced. name_mapped = a build_menu price whose in-game name differs from the name used in the official mission list; the mapping is an assumption.

small_counts_same.note: A small station counts identically to a full station toward a mission's station-count requirement. It holds 6 vehicles and can carry only ONE extension. Upgrading to a full station later costs the difference and takes 24 hours. Because of this the planner prices growth with SMALL stations by default.

price_escalation.value: rises after the 24th station of a type
price_escalation.note: Exact formula unconfirmed. A community formula 100000+(200000*log2(n-22)) was posted and then disputed in the same thread. Do NOT hardcode it. Let the user type the real price of their next station instead.

dispatch_centers.value: 1 + 1 per 15 buildings, dispatch centers themselves not counted
dispatch_centers.note: Free to build. This corrects two earlier wrong numbers: the official help centre said station_count/25 and a fan table said 1 per 10. Both were used in earlier reasoning and both are wrong.

clinic.note: 10 patient cap, general internal extension only

coastal_air_station.note: not present in the player's build menu, probably locked. Unlock rate disputed: 1 per 6 coastal rescue stations (wiki table) vs 1 per 20 (other source).

firefighting_plane_station.note: not present in the player's build menu, probably locked

classroom_expansion.WARNING: This came from a Leitstellenspiel source, NOT from MissionChief. It is used in the alliance kit's ratio rules and must be verified in a MissionChief academy build menu before it is trusted.

extensions._comment: Keys are the names EXACTLY as they appear in the mission list requirements, because that is what the planner matches against.

Detention Unit Extension.note: corrected from 25000; 25000 was the price of a prison cell, a different thing

Federal Police Station.note: The mission list says 'Federal Police Station'. The player's police station build menu has a 'Federal Police Extension' at 200000 and there is NO standalone Federal Police Station in their building menu. An older wiki table claimed a 500000 standalone building requiring rank Staff Captain; that table has proven unreliable. ASSUMPTION: they are the same thing. Affects 55 missions including most top-tier fire missions.

Traffic Police Extension.note: The player's POLICE station menu has 'Traffic Control Extension' at 200000. A FIRE station 'Traffic Control Extension' was also mentioned in an earlier conversation. If these are two different extensions this price may belong to the wrong one.

Lifeguard Post or Coastal Rescue Station.note: requirement is satisfied by either; priced as the cheaper Lifeguard Post

Disaster Response Extension.priority: HIGH — gates the fire path at ~1.85M

Flood Control Extension.priority: HIGH — gates the fire path at ~1.85M

Mountain Rescue Station.priority: MEDIUM — carries the EMS avalanche branch

Technical Rescue Equipment.priority: MEDIUM — gates Roller Coaster Derailment, 40000 credits

Prison cell.note: Owned by the player and named by the game, but gates no mission, so it never reaches the ladder. docs/CORRECTIONS.md mentions 25,000 while correcting a different mistake; that figure was never confirmed on its own. Takes 7 days to build - see docs/VERIFICATION.md.

Additional cell.note: Second cell on a police station or prison. Gates no mission. Build time measured at exactly 7.000 days across five stations.

Mass Casualty Trailer Extension.note: On an ambulance station. Gates no mission in the current dataset.
